The '''Raioballo sector''' was a [[sector]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[planet]]s [[Dantooine]] and [[Lah'mu]]. The [[Chopani sector]] was located to the north-east, the [[Myto sector]] to the west, [[Clacis sector]] to the south-west and the [[Relgim sector]] to the south.<ref name="RO World Locations" />
